description_en: Digital Employee > Global Configuration > Add Instruction
description_zh: 数字员工-全局配置-添加指令
kebab_example: aliyun voicenavigator create-instruction --instance-id 36e9a4cd-a821-4f78-86fa-a9a4aefeea2e --type TRANSFER --code Transfer00 --name '转人工指令一' --config '{"providerId":"xxxxxxxxx","transferMethod":"BYE","transferType":"External","transferTarget":"152******","transferor":"01*****","timeoutSeconds":"10"}' --api-version 2025-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstruction

parameters.help_en:
The instruction code.
<notice>The code must be globally unique.></notice>
parameters.name: code

parameters.help_en:
The configuration for the instruction, in JSON format.

providerId: The ID of the call center provider. To obtain this ID, call the ListCallCenterProviders operation.

transferMethod: The method used to transfer the call. Valid values: BYE, BRIDGE, and REFER.

transferType: The transfer destination type. Valid values: External (an external number), Agent (an agent), and SkillGroup (a skill group).

transferTarget: The transfer destination. The value of this parameter depends on the value of transferType.

transferor: The caller ID displayed for the transferred call. If this parameter is empty, the system defaults to the original caller's number.

timeoutSeconds: The transfer timeout, in seconds. The default is 30
parameters.help_zh:
指令配置

providerId：人工服务提供商id,可通过ListCallCenterProviders 获取
transferMethod：转接方式 (BYE，BRIDGE，REFER)
transferType：转接目标类型 (External:外部号码, Agent:坐席,SkillGroup:技能组)
transferTarget:转接目标
transferor:主叫号码(为空则默认使用客户来电手机号码)
timeoutSeconds:超时时间，单位：秒（转人工超时时间，默认 30 秒）
parameters.name: config
